section.title: All Metrics (Full Detail)
section.content:
Metrics: 3
## Real-Time Factor Key: rtf Unit: ratio Value type: float Version: 1
Synthesis wall time divided by output audio duration. RTF < 1.0 means faster than real time. Lower is better.
## Speaker Similarity (GE2E Cosine) Key: speaker_sim Unit: ratio Value type: float Version: 1
Cosine similarity between synthesized clip GE2E embedding and mean GE2E embedding of ElevenLabs David reference set. Computed via resemblyzer. Higher is better.
## Time to First Byte (ms) Key: ttfb_ms Unit: ms Value type: float Version: 1
Wall-clock milliseconds from TTS request issue to first audio byte received. Measured locally (same-machine or loopback). Report p50, p95, p99. Lower is better.
